focused_validation.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run pytest -q tests/test_chart_intelligence.py tests/test_chart_overlay_contract.py tests/test_chart_intelligence_stress.py
checks: malformed timestamps, OHLC bounds, negative volume, and unsupported fields fail closed
Europe/London post-fallback session boundary uses the correct UTC offset
256 overlays are accepted and 257 overlays fail closed at the packet cap
20,000-bar prefix replay matches the full input at the same cutoff

limits.detail: One packet is limited to 256 overlays; larger groups must be paginated or windowed.
Wall-clock sessions crossing an autumn DST fold can emit a close/reopen pair across the repeated local hour; a future slice must choose an explicit fold policy.
The 100,000-bar probe is a runtime signal only; no production SLO or concurrent-stream capacity claim is made.
